I am aware this repurchase falls inside the 30-day wash-sale window from my 2026-07-08 loss sale (the /tax page's own wash-sale panel put the safe-to-repurchase date at 2026-08-08); re-entering anyway because the trend thesis, not the tax treatment, drives the call, and a disallowed loss is deferred into the new lot's basis, not lost. Deliberately testing whether the per-ticker wash-sale panel updates the deferred amount and window status once this fill lands.
